addedBefore: any untouched page request (written during development on the development pages only)

scoringAdditions.duplicateLeads: Within one document, leads (and, separately, qualitative findings) with the same value, unit and subject (findings: dimension, direction and subject) count once: a result repeated in a summary box and in the body is one finding, for every arm alike.
scoringAdditions.conditions: A candidate's recognised conditions are its Phase225/270 codes mapped by codeToConditionMap plus, for plan-guided candidates, planConditionIds272 (taught condition ids whose terms the value's sentence uses: a cue that the condition is stated, not proof that it is met).
